resources.string: Trusted by apps that don\'t opt into user certs — the modern-SDK default. Needs a device reboot to take effect (Magisk/KernelSU/APatch module).
The module is staged. Rebooting now will restart the device and merge it into the system trust store. Every running app (including this bridge\'s own connection) will restart too.
The module is marked for removal. Rebooting now will restart the device and drop the CA from the system trust store.

One-time setup: downloads frida-inject matched to this device\'s real CPU architecture. Once enabled, a pentest agent can request cert/SSL-pinning bypass injection into a specific running app — this toggle only stages the tool, it never injects anything by itself.
Lets Strobes Bridge automate taps, swipes, typing, and screenshots on this device without root — used only while a pentest engagement you paired this device to is actively driving it.
Root available — full shell automation active; this fallback isn\'t needed.

No root detected. Enable the Accessibility Service below to unlock non-root tap/swipe/type/screenshot automation — everything else (arbitrary shell, IMEI/SMS, pm install, system-wide traffic interception) still needs root and has no substitute.

Without root: tap, swipe, type (into the focused field), screenshot (Android 11+), UI dump, launch an app by package or component.\nStill needs root: arbitrary shell commands, IMEI/SMS, installing/clearing apps, system-wide traffic interception.
No traffic captured yet.\nBrowse any app on this device — capture runs automatically once the bridge is started.
No traffic captured yet.\nBrowse any app on this device — capture runs automatically once the bridge is started.
Test devices only — never install on a personal device.
This app is for provisioned test devices only

Strobes Bridge installs a local MITM proxy and (optionally) automates the device on behalf of a pentest engagement. Only install it on a device that has been provisioned specifically for testing on the Strobes platform. Never install it on a personal device, or a device with personal accounts, photos, messages, or other sensitive data — this app can read traffic, SMS, and other data on the device it runs on.
I confirm this is a device provisioned for Strobes testing, not a personal device
Root access detected — every capability below works at full strength, no extra setup needed.
No root detected on this device. The steps that follow set up the non-root fallback path: Accessibility automation, permission grants, and a user-trusted CA cert.
Grant these so the non-root path can read SMS (OTP automation), phone state, media, and location when a test calls for it. None of these require root.
Enables tap, swipe, type, screenshot, and UI-dump automation without root — the same actions a pentest agent drives via root shell on a rooted device.
Trust the local proxy\'s CA cert
One tap writes the cert straight into the user trust store as root — no dialog needed.

Android doesn\'t let an app install a CA certificate on your behalf anymore — download the cert file below, then add it yourself from Settings. Needed for HTTPS traffic capture to work in apps that opt into user certs.

If \"Install certificate\" above doesn\'t open the system installer: Settings → Security → More security settings → Encryption & credentials → \"Install a certificate\" → \"CA certificate\" → confirm the warning → browse to Downloads and pick the file. Come back here — the status below updates once it\'s trusted.
Head back to the main screen, fill in your pairing details (or scan the pairing QR code), and start the bridge.
